newsitem.title: USA: Nextel to repurchase option from Comcast.
newsitem.headline: Nextel to repurchase option from Comcast.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc said Tuesday that it had reached a definitive agreement with Comcast Corp to repurchase a previously issued and outstanding option covering 25 million Nextel shares.

Under the pact, Nextel will acquire from a Comcast affiliate the outstanding option, which is exercisable for up to 25 million shares of Nextel common stock at $16 per share on or before September 15 for $25 million cash, Nextel said.
Nextel said the transaction removes Comcast's anti-dilutive right to purchase additional shares of Nextel stock and its right to nominate board members.

"Freeing these 25 million shares from this issuance commitment returns to Nextel the ability to control their placement and gives us much more flexibility in exploring and structuring potential transactions with others who may wish to acquire strategic equity positions in Nextel," Nextel said in a release.

Nextel Communications, based in McLean, Va., provides all-digital wireless services. Comcast develops and operates wired telecommunications, including cable television and telephone services, and wireless telecommunications. It has principal ownership of QVC, an electronic retailer.
